datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2014 across Burkina Faso administrative units. The classifications represent food insecurity phases derived from standardized IPC methodology and were compiled into geographic datasets for January, April, July, and October 2014 snapshots.
